---
title: "Letter and invoice"
subtitle: "Two PDF types with an address window and fold marks."
description: "The letter and invoice types of the mcanouil extension: their fields, the NF Z 11-001 and DIN 5008 standards, the languages, and the page furniture."
---

The `letter` and `invoice` types render in `mcanouil-typst` only.
In another format, the render stops with a message that names the type and `mcanouil-typst`.

## Letter

The field names are those of [quarto-letter](https://github.com/mcanouil/quarto-letter), so a quarto-letter document needs no changes.

```yaml
title: "Training proposal"
lang: en-GB
date: 2026-11-11
sender:
  name: Mickaël Canouil
  address:
    - 12 Example Street
    - Lille
  email: mickael@example.org
place: Lille
reference: "2026-014"
your-reference: "AB-12"
subject: "Training proposal"
address:
  - Company Ltd
  - 10 Station Road
  - London
opening: "Dear Sir or Madam,"
closing: "Yours faithfully,"
signature-image: signature.svg
cc:
  - Alex Copy
encl:
  - Programme
ps: "Remember the date."
format: mcanouil-typst
extensions:
  mcanouil:
    type: letter
```

| Field | Content |
| --- | --- |
| `sender` | `name`, `address` (list of lines), `email`, `phone`. If it is not set, the letter uses the name of the first author. |
| `address` | Recipient, as a list of lines, in the address window. |
| `place`, `date` | Place and date line. |
| `reference`, `your-reference` | Reference line, or the reference block in DIN 5008. |
| `subject` | Subject line. |
| `opening`, `closing` | Salutation and complimentary close. |
| `signature-image` | Image of the signature. Its alt text comes from the labels. |
| `cc`, `encl`, `ps` | Copies, enclosures and postscript. |

: The fields of a letter. {.striped .hover tbl-colwidths="[28,72]"}

The body of the document is the body of the letter.

## Invoice

The data model is that of [quarto-invoice](https://github.com/mcanouil/quarto-invoice).

```yaml
title: "Consulting 2026"
lang: en-GB
sender:
  name: Mickaël Canouil
  email: mickael@example.org
  registration: "123 456 789"
  vat: FR1234567890
  address:
    street: 12 Example Street
    zip: 59000
    city: Lille
    country: France
recipient:
  name: Company Ltd
  address:
    street: 10 Station Road
    zip: 75008
    city: Paris
    country: France
invoice:
  number: "2026-014"
  issued: 2026-11-01
  due: 2026-12-01
  reference: REF-2026-014
  fee: 2.28
  penalty: 40
  currency: EUR
  items:
    - description: Workshop
      details: Two days on site
      quantity: 2
      unit-price: 1200
      vat: 20
bank:
  bic: AZERTYUI
  iban: FR12 1234 4567 7890 1234 5678 901
format: mcanouil-typst
extensions:
  mcanouil:
    type: invoice
```

- Typst calculates the totals in the smallest unit of the currency, so 3 × 33.33 gives 99.99.
- The VAT shows for each rate.
- `sender: exempted: true` removes the VAT column and adds the exemption label.
  A text value adds your own mention.
- `fee` is the late fee in percent, and `penalty` is the fixed recovery cost.
- The items table has tagged header cells and tabular figures.

## Standards

The `letter-standard` option sets the page geometry of a letter and an invoice.

| Value | Standard | Address window |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `nf` | NF Z 11-001 | Right, fold marks at thirds. |
| `din` | DIN 5008 form B | Left, with a reference block, fold marks and a punch mark. |

: The two letter standards. {.striped .hover tbl-colwidths="[14,28,58]"}

If you do not set `letter-standard`, the document language selects the standard:

- `lang: fr` gives `nf`.
- `lang: de` gives `din`.
- Any other language gives `nf`.

```yaml
extensions:
  mcanouil:
    type: letter
    letter-standard: din
```

::: {.callout-warning}

The NF Z 11-001 dimensions come from secondary sources, because the standard text is not free.
They are not verified against the AFNOR standard.
Before you print letters for window envelopes, do a test print with one envelope.

:::

The DIN 5008 dimensions come from published descriptions of form B.
The marks are artefacts in the PDF tags.
The PDF does not draw the window outline, because an outline shows through the envelope window.

## Languages

Letter and invoice labels exist in English and French.
German (`lang: de`) has the letter labels only, for example "Ihr Zeichen" and "Unser Zeichen".
A German invoice uses the English labels.
To add your own labels, see [Labels and dates](typst-format.qmd#labels-and-dates).

## Page furniture

The first page has the corner motif of the preset, so the footer starts on page 2.
The default footer of both types shows the page number in the right slot.

gitlink is off by default in letters and invoices.
As a result, a reference such as `abcd1234` shows as written, not as a link to a commit.
To turn gitlink on, set `extensions: gitlink: enabled: true`.
